bio.text: Tony Sabio is the Republican nominee for Virginia's 8th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election, challenging Rep. Don Beyer.
The Virginia Mercury describes him as a security expert who served in the U.S. military, the Secret Service and the CIA, where he worked as a counterintelligence and counterterrorism officer.
He runs a security consultancy, the Rockfinn Group, lives in Lorton, and recently served a short term as interim Town Manager of Purcellville.

sources.title: Republican veteran Tony Sabio is on a 'mission' to win Va.'s most Democratic US House seat
